chats.answer:
Yes, you can use a smartwatch without a phone, but it depends on whether you want to use it completely independently or just leave your phone at home.

There are three types:

Type

	

Phone needed?

	

What it can do




Bluetooth smartwatch

	

Usually for setup

	

Fitness tracking, alarms, offline features




LTE / Cellular smartwatch

	

Often for initial setup

	

Calls, texts, GPS, music, internet




Standalone 4G smartwatch

	

Some models don't need one at all

	

Calls, texts, apps with its own SIM

Important: Even cellular versions of Apple Watch and Samsung Galaxy Watch generally require a compatible smartphone for initial setup, although some family setup options exist.

Smartwatches worth considering
